payload.text: Devbin 0.1.19 sweep, the one Molt item that moves while decision 43 parks the rest: when it reaches Molt, devbin-vc commits the vendored bin/.devbin pathspec in Molt's tree with START and END to vc; hold the tree clean for it. hv accepted devbin's XDG cache default, ~/.cache/devbin, and Molt, Molt-matts and Molt-flynn set neither DEVBIN_CACHE_HOME nor XDG_CACHE_HOME (vc's grep, 1 Nov).
